coastal.title: Hiker missing from B.C. gondola made call to 911 saying he's 'stuck on the mountain'
coastal.description: Search and rescue crews say a hiker who's been missing from the Squamish area since Sunday managed to briefly get through to 911 on Tuesday, but that searchers still haven't been able to find him.

kamloops.title: 'My students should be here': Tumbler Ridge teacher shares toll of deadly school shooting

prince-george.title: 6,000 names etched in stone to memorialize Japanese people detained in Vancouver during WWII
prince-george.description: A memorial for Japanese Canadians detained during the Second World War was unveiled at Vancouver's Hastings Park last week, commemorating the thousands of people who were held there while more permanent internment camps were built.
